notes: Three things were left open truthfully rather than closed by guessing. (1) The `audits` surface R0-08's objective names has no derivable entry: the source's 'Reconciliation and audits' section is prose with no Decision line and no owner, fixture or evidence cell, so it is enumerated as a permanent surface-without-row finding instead of being given an invented status. Closing it needs an edit to docs/product-plan/reference/feature-parity.md, which is in R0-08's graph lease but outside this run's narrowed ownership. (2) One row of 40 fits no status in the closed set — codex-worker-guard-hooks-and-sandbox-launcher, whose decision reads 'Strengthen before native adapter cutover' — and is recorded unclassified with a finding. That is a stop condition in the contract, reported here rather than resolved, because choosing between isolate and preserve for a sandbox-hardening row is an owner decision. (3) The source's own prose declares 15 fully pinned and 5 partially pinned rows; the table cells measure 14 and 6. Totals agree (39) and the load-bearing count agrees (19 unevidenced, matching the 19 rows citing the decision), so the divergence is recorded as two declared-count-divergence findings with the measured values authoritative. It is not silently corrected in either direction. The findings array is part of the byte-compared generated output, so a later prose fix that is not regenerated fails the drift check — the findings are enforced, not decorative. Two design choices worth a reviewer's attention: the section-decision entry (Interactive shells and file transfer) is derived from the source's literal 'Decision: **...**' line, which is the only prose disposition the source states in a machine-readable shape, and it is the only entry carrying the `isolate` status; and `retire only by decision` has zero entries, which is a measured fact about the source, not a gap in the vocabulary. plan/gate.py --item R0-08 --dry-run refuses this candidate for one reason only, and the refusal is correct: 'REFUSE: no specification-debt counter decreased' (exit 1), because parity_ledger_fields_missing was already 0 at the base. Everything else the gate judges passed in that same run — readiness, the five-file lease, all seven contract checks answered, the review record, and plan integrity at debt 94 / digest 1a18155d. Re-run with the reason the gate itself asks for, --allow-no-metric-change 'parity_ledger_fields_missing was measured at 0 before this work and is 0 after ...', it returns 'gate: PASS' with attestation Automonique-Review: 0-pass/0-blocking. Both runs are reported verbatim in the result report; the refusal is not worked around, it is the correct verdict on a counter that was already at its floor. No subagent was launched; the unit is one generator, one checker and one test module with a shared source of truth.
